title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 04/27 — "The Cylinder Opens"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 4. The narrator comes back over Horsell Common with the sun going down and finds two or three hundred people round the pit, black against a lemon sky. A boy runs the other way shouting that the thing is moving. The railing he fetched Lord Hilton for that afternoon is trodden flat in the sand, Stent is shouting at the crowd to keep back, and a young shopman has been pushed in and cannot climb out.

Then the end of the cylinder is screwed out from within, the lid falls on the gravel with a ringing concussion, and out of the black hole comes a greyish bulk the size of a bear, glistening like wet leather, with two great dark eyes and a quivering V-shaped mouth. The crowd empties. The narrator runs a hundred yards and stops among the pines, and from there he watches the shopman's head bob at the edge of the pit until it does not come up again.

Chapter IV of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
